paragraphs.en: Agent workspace built on Cloudflare Workers for creating documents, building apps, and running agents with your company’s context and systems.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的智能体工作区，可用于创建文档、构建应用，并结合公司的上下文与系统运行智能体。

paragraphs.en: Cloudflare OS is an "operating system" for AI productivity originally developed for use inside Cloudflare. A large portion of Cloudflare's workforce -- from engineering to sales and everything in between -- uses Cloudflare OS every day to help them do their jobs.
paragraphs.zh: Cloudflare OS 是一个最初为 Cloudflare 内部使用而开发的 AI 生产力“操作系统”。 Cloudflare 的大部分员工——从工程到销售以及介于两者之间的各个岗位——每天都使用 Cloudflare OS 来帮助他们完成工作。

paragraphs.en: Cloudflare OS is more than just another chatbox with connectors. The system revolves around a new approach to software, where every user runs their own copy of the productivity apps they use.
paragraphs.zh: Cloudflare OS 不仅仅是一个又一个带连接器的聊天框。 该系统围绕一种新的软件方式展开：每位用户都运行自己所用效率应用的专属副本。

sents.en: Cloudflare OS is more than just another chatbox with connectors.
sents.zh: Cloudflare OS 不仅仅是一个又一个带连接器的聊天框。

sents.en: The system revolves around a new approach to software, where every user runs their own copy of the productivity apps they use.
sents.zh: 该系统围绕一种新的软件方式展开：每位用户都运行自己所用效率应用的专属副本。

paragraphs.en: When you create a slide deck in Cloudflare OS, you are not calling out to some SaaS software running in the cloud. The system creates a private instance of the slide deck software just for you . We call this a "gadget". This instance runs in a separate sandbox from everyone else's slide decks.
paragraphs.zh: 当你在 Cloudflare OS 中创建幻灯片文稿时，你并不是在调用运行于云端的某种 SaaS 软件。 系统会专门为你创建一个幻灯片软件的私有实例。我们称之为「gadget（小工具）」。 该实例运行在与其他所有人的幻灯片相隔离的独立沙箱中。

sents.zh: 当你在 Cloudflare OS 中创建幻灯片文稿时，你并不是在调用运行于云端的某种 SaaS 软件。

sents.zh: 该实例运行在与其他所有人的幻灯片相隔离的独立沙箱中。

paragraphs.en: This is a big departure from the last 25 years of cloud architecture and "Software as a Service", but we think AI has changed the equation. When any user is capable of prompting an agent to add the features they need, the centralized model of software stops making sense.
paragraphs.zh: 这与过去25年的云架构和“软件即服务”模式大相径庭，但我们认为AI已经改变了这一格局。 当任何用户都能够通过提示词让智能体添加他们所需的功能时，软件的集中化模式就失去了意义。

paragraphs.en: Gatekeepers are like supercharged MCP servers.
paragraphs.zh: Gatekeeper 就像是增强版的 MCP 服务器。

paragraphs.en: On the last point, Gatekeepers implement a significant advancement in the state of the art. Traditionally, human-in-the-loop setups require the human to approve actions synchronously . When the agent wants to do something, it has to stop and wait for said approval before it can continue. This is annoying: you give your agent a task, then walk away and get a coffee, only to come back and find the agent got stuck on an approval on the first step and has made no progress. As a result, people often give in and set their agents to "auto-approve", or --dangerously-skip-permissions , which is, obviously, unsafe.
paragraphs.zh: 关于最后一点，守门人（Gatekeepers）实现了对现有技术水平的重大进步。 传统上，人在回路（human-in-the-loop）的设置要求人类同步批准操作。 当智能体想要做某件事时，它必须停下来等待上述批准，然后才能继续。 这很烦人：你给智能体一个任务，然后走开去喝杯咖啡，回来却发现智能体在第一步就被一个批准卡住了，毫无进展。 因此，人们往往会妥协，将智能体设置为“自动批准”（auto-approve），或者使用 --dangerously-skip-permissions，这显然是不安全的。

sents.en: On the last point, Gatekeepers implement a significant advancement in the state of the art.
sents.zh: 关于最后一点，守门人（Gatekeepers）实现了对现有技术水平的重大进步。

sents.en: Traditionally, human-in-the-loop setups require the human to approve actions synchronously .
sents.zh: 传统上，人在回路（human-in-the-loop）的设置要求人类同步批准操作。

sents.en: When the agent wants to do something, it has to stop and wait for said approval before it can continue.
sents.zh: 当智能体想要做某件事时，它必须停下来等待上述批准，然后才能继续。

sents.en: This is annoying: you give your agent a task, then walk away and get a coffee, only to come back and find the agent got stuck on an approval on the first step and has made no progress.
sents.zh: 这很烦人：你给智能体一个任务，然后走开去喝杯咖啡，回来却发现智能体在第一步就被一个批准卡住了，毫无进展。

sents.en: As a result, people often give in and set their agents to "auto-approve", or --dangerously-skip-permissions , which is, obviously, unsafe.
sents.zh: 因此，人们往往会妥协，将智能体设置为“自动批准”（auto-approve），或者使用 --dangerously-skip-permissions，这显然是不安全的。

paragraphs.en: Gatekeepers provide a better way: When the agent (or Gadget) performs an action that requires approval, the Gatekeeper will simulate the outcome locally, allowing the agent to proceed and queue up more actions. The Gatekeeper tells the agent that the action completed, and if the agent tries to read back the results, the Gatekeeper gives it simulated results. Once the agent is done, the user may approve or reject the actions in bulk, or one-by-one, but either way, they can do it later, when it is convenient.
paragraphs.zh: 门控机制提供了一种更好的方式：当智能体（或 Gadget）执行需要批准的操作时，门控器会在本地模拟该操作的结果，让智能体得以继续执行并排队更多操作。 门控器会告知智能体该操作已完成，如果智能体尝试读取结果，门控器会向其提供模拟的结果。 智能体完成后，用户可以批量批准或拒绝这些操作，也可以逐个处理，但无论哪种方式，都可以在方便的时候再进行。

paragraphs.en: Logistically, each Gatekeeper is implemented as a separate Worker. In the future, we envision Gatekeeper services being deployed and maintained independently from OS instances, but the details have yet to be worked out. For now, we have provided a few interesting Gatekeepers in this repository which you can deploy together with your own OS instance.
paragraphs.zh: 在部署安排上，每个 Gatekeeper 都实现为一个单独的 Worker。 在未来，我们设想 Gatekeeper 服务将独立于 OS 实例进行部署和维护，但具体细节尚待确定。 目前，我们在此仓库中提供了几个有趣的 Gatekeeper，你可以将其与自己的 OS 实例一起部署。

paragraphs.en: The basic user experience of Cloudflare OS is something like an online office suite, like Google Docs or MS Office. But, imagine that instead of a fixed set of file types (document, spreadsheet, slide deck), each file -- or "Gadget" -- is potentially its own custom application, written by AI to serve exactly your needs.
paragraphs.zh: Cloudflare OS 的基础用户体验类似于在线办公套件，比如 Google Docs 或 MS Office。 但是，请想象一下：这里没有固定的一组文件类型（文档、电子表格、幻灯片），而是每个文件——或者说「Gadget」——都可能是其自身的定制应用，由 AI 编写，精准满足你的需求。

sents.en: The basic user experience of Cloudflare OS is something like an online office suite, like Google Docs or MS Office.
sents.zh: Cloudflare OS 的基础用户体验类似于在线办公套件，比如 Google Docs 或 MS Office。

sents.en: But, imagine that instead of a fixed set of file types (document, spreadsheet, slide deck), each file -- or "Gadget" -- is potentially its own custom application, written by AI to serve exactly your needs.
sents.zh: 但是，请想象一下：这里没有固定的一组文件类型（文档、电子表格、幻灯片），而是每个文件——或者说「Gadget」——都可能是其自身的定制应用，由 AI 编写，精准满足你的需求。

paragraphs.en: Just like office docs, each gadget is private by default, but can be shared -- securely -- in order to collaborate with your team or your friends.
paragraphs.zh: 与办公文档一样，每个小工具默认都是私有的，但也可以共享——安全地共享——以便与你的团队或朋友进行协作。

paragraphs.en: Just like office docs, you can have thousands of them. You can create them on a whim.
paragraphs.zh: 就像办公文档一样，你可以拥有成千上万个智能体。 你可以随心所欲地创建智能体。

sents.en: Just like office docs, you can have thousands of them.
sents.zh: 就像办公文档一样，你可以拥有成千上万个智能体。

sents.en: You can create them on a whim.
sents.zh: 你可以随心所欲地创建智能体。

paragraphs.en: Just like office docs, you can start from "templates" -- called "Blueprints". But where an office template is just some content, a Blueprint specifies a whole application.
paragraphs.zh: 就像办公文档一样，你可以从「模板」开始——这里称为「蓝图」。 但办公模板只是一些内容，而蓝图则定义了整个应用程序。

sents.en: Just like office docs, you can start from "templates" -- called "Blueprints".
sents.zh: 就像办公文档一样，你可以从「模板」开始——这里称为「蓝图」。

sents.en: But where an office template is just some content, a Blueprint specifies a whole application.
sents.zh: 但办公模板只是一些内容，而蓝图则定义了整个应用程序。

paragraphs.en: Like office docs, you can create new templates (blueprints) from your own docs (Gadgets) and share them with others. But when you do so, you are sharing the code for a whole app.
paragraphs.zh: 与办公文档类似，你可以根据自己的文档（Gadgets）创建新模板（blueprints），并与其他人共享。 但这样做时，你共享的是整个应用的代码。

sents.en: Like office docs, you can create new templates (blueprints) from your own docs (Gadgets) and share them with others.
sents.zh: 与办公文档类似，你可以根据自己的文档（Gadgets）创建新模板（blueprints），并与其他人共享。

sents.en: But when you do so, you are sharing the code for a whole app.
sents.zh: 但这样做时，你共享的是整个应用的代码。

paragraphs.en: The OS terminology isn't entirely marketing. Cloudflare OS is actually analogous to an operating system on a technical level.
paragraphs.zh: 这套“操作系统”的叫法并不完全是营销话术。 从技术层面来说，Cloudflare OS 实际上确实类似于一个操作系统。

sents.en: The OS terminology isn't entirely marketing.
sents.zh: 这套“操作系统”的叫法并不完全是营销话术。

sents.en: Cloudflare OS is actually analogous to an operating system on a technical level.
sents.zh: 从技术层面来说，Cloudflare OS 实际上确实类似于一个操作系统。

paragraphs.en: Our "kernel" is in the workshop-backend package. The backend legitimately does a lot of things similar to real OS kernels: it connects users to programs and devices (Gadgets and Gatekeepers, as we call them) while implementing security by sandboxing applications and enforcing access control.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的「内核」位于 workshop-backend 包中。 后端确实做了许多类似真实操作系统内核的事情：它将用户连接到程序和设备（我们称之为 Gadgets 和 Gatekeepers），同时通过沙箱隔离应用程序并实施访问控制来实现安全性。

sents.en: Our "kernel" is in the workshop-backend package.
sents.zh: 我们的「内核」位于 workshop-backend 包中。

sents.en: The backend legitimately does a lot of things similar to real OS kernels: it connects users to programs and devices (Gadgets and Gatekeepers, as we call them) while implementing security by sandboxing applications and enforcing access control.
sents.zh: 后端确实做了许多类似真实操作系统内核的事情：它将用户连接到程序和设备（我们称之为 Gadgets 和 Gatekeepers），同时通过沙箱隔离应用程序并实施访问控制来实现安全性。

paragraphs.en: In this analogy, Gatekeepers -- which connect users and agents to external services -- are like drivers -- which connect users and programs to external devices.
paragraphs.zh: 在这个类比中，网关——它将用户和智能体连接到外部服务——就像驱动程序——它将用户和程序连接到外部设备。

paragraphs.en: There is one thing that traditional OSes don't really manage today, but Cloudflare OS does: AI agents. If you think about it, this is really a missing feature in traditional OSes. We believe that AI agents cannot simply be treated as users. They must be accountable to a human user, while at the same time having their own restricted permissions. Agents do work by writing snippets of code and executing them on the fly. The ideal security model for all of this is capability-based security, not access control lists. See what I mean? Perhaps traditional OSes ought to give AI agents special treatment, too.
paragraphs.zh: 有一点是传统操作系统目前并未真正管理的，而 Cloudflare OS 却管理了：智能体。 仔细想想，这确实是传统操作系统缺失的一项功能。 我们认为，AI 智能体不能简单地被当作用户来对待。 它们必须对人类用户负责，同时拥有自己受到限制的权限。 智能体的工作方式是编写代码片段并即时执行它们。 所有这一切的理想安全模型是基于能力的安全，而不是访问控制列表。明白我的意思吗？ 或许传统操作系统也应该给 AI 智能体特殊对待。

sents.en: There is one thing that traditional OSes don't really manage today, but Cloudflare OS does: AI agents.
sents.zh: 有一点是传统操作系统目前并未真正管理的，而 Cloudflare OS 却管理了：智能体。

sents.en: If you think about it, this is really a missing feature in traditional OSes.
sents.zh: 仔细想想，这确实是传统操作系统缺失的一项功能。

sents.en: We believe that AI agents cannot simply be treated as users.
sents.zh: 我们认为，AI 智能体不能简单地被当作用户来对待。

sents.en: They must be accountable to a human user, while at the same time having their own restricted permissions.
sents.zh: 它们必须对人类用户负责，同时拥有自己受到限制的权限。

sents.en: Agents do work by writing snippets of code and executing them on the fly.
sents.zh: 智能体的工作方式是编写代码片段并即时执行它们。

sents.en: The ideal security model for all of this is capability-based security, not access control lists. See what I mean?
sents.zh: 所有这一切的理想安全模型是基于能力的安全，而不是访问控制列表。明白我的意思吗？

sents.en: Perhaps traditional OSes ought to give AI agents special treatment, too.
sents.zh: 或许传统操作系统也应该给 AI 智能体特殊对待。

paragraphs.en: Cloudflare OS is built on Cloudflare Workers , making heavy use of Durable Objects , Dynamic Workers , and Facets in particular. Every workspace is its own Durable Object, every Gadget runs in a Dynamic Worker Facet, and Gatekeepers also install facets into each workspace to manage access to remote services.
paragraphs.zh: Cloudflare OS 构建在 Cloudflare Workers 之上，尤其大量使用了 Durable Objects、Dynamic Workers 和 Facets。 每个工作区（workspace）都是它自己的 Durable Object，每个 Gadget 都运行在一个 Dynamic Worker Facet 中，而 Gatekeeper 也会向每个工作区安装 Facet，以管理对远程服务的访问。

sents.en: Cloudflare OS is built on Cloudflare Workers , making heavy use of Durable Objects , Dynamic Workers , and Facets in particular.
sents.zh: Cloudflare OS 构建在 Cloudflare Workers 之上，尤其大量使用了 Durable Objects、Dynamic Workers 和 Facets。

sents.en: Every workspace is its own Durable Object, every Gadget runs in a Dynamic Worker Facet, and Gatekeepers also install facets into each workspace to manage access to remote services.
sents.zh: 每个工作区（workspace）都是它自己的 Durable Object，每个 Gadget 都运行在一个 Dynamic Worker Facet 中，而 Gatekeeper 也会向每个工作区安装 Facet，以管理对远程服务的访问。

paragraphs.en: Cloudflare OS is, in fact, built by the very people who built Workers itself. It uses cutting-edge features of the Workers Runtime -- in fact, Dynamic Workers, Facets, and several other features were added to the runtime specifically to support Cloudflare OS, with more to come. Studying the Cloudflare OS source code is a great way to understand how the Workers Runtime team thinks Workers should be used.
paragraphs.zh: Cloudflare OS 实际上正是由构建 Workers 本身的那些人打造的。 它使用了 Workers 运行时的前沿特性——事实上，Dynamic Workers、Facets 以及其他若干特性正是为了支持 Cloudflare OS 而专门添加到运行时中的，未来还会有更多。 研究 Cloudflare OS 的源代码是理解 Workers 运行时团队认为 Workers 应该如何使用的一个绝佳途径。

sents.en: Cloudflare OS is, in fact, built by the very people who built Workers itself.
sents.zh: Cloudflare OS 实际上正是由构建 Workers 本身的那些人打造的。

sents.en: It uses cutting-edge features of the Workers Runtime -- in fact, Dynamic Workers, Facets, and several other features were added to the runtime specifically to support Cloudflare OS, with more to come.

sents.en: Studying the Cloudflare OS source code is a great way to understand how the Workers Runtime team thinks Workers should be used.
sents.zh: 研究 Cloudflare OS 的源代码是理解 Workers 运行时团队认为 Workers 应该如何使用的一个绝佳途径。

paragraphs.en: Being built on Workers does not mean that Cloudflare OS can only run on Cloudflare. In fact, workerd , the Cloudflare Workers Runtime, is itself open source , and Cloudflare OS can run entirely on top of it on your own servers.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 Workers 构建并不意味着 Cloudflare OS 只能运行在 Cloudflare 上。 事实上，Cloudflare Workers 的运行时 workerd 本身就是开源的，Cloudflare OS 可以完全基于它在您自己的服务器上运行。

sents.en: Being built on Workers does not mean that Cloudflare OS can only run on Cloudflare.
sents.zh: 基于 Workers 构建并不意味着 Cloudflare OS 只能运行在 Cloudflare 上。

sents.en: In fact, workerd , the Cloudflare Workers Runtime, is itself open source , and Cloudflare OS can run entirely on top of it on your own servers.
sents.zh: 事实上，Cloudflare Workers 的运行时 workerd 本身就是开源的，Cloudflare OS 可以完全基于它在您自己的服务器上运行。

paragraphs.en: The Cloudflare OS coding agent is actually a fully multi-purpose agent that can perform arbitrary tasks; like other popular coding agents, you don't have to code with it. You can use it to build Gadgets, but you can also skip the Gadget and just have the agent perform tasks directly. The Cloudflare OS agent is a Code Mode agent -- it performs tasks by writing and immediately executing snippets of code. It can be connected to external resources using Gatekeepers (like MCP -- see below).
paragraphs.zh: Cloudflare OS 编码智能体实际上是一个完全通用的智能体，可以执行任意任务；和其他流行的编码智能体一样，你不必用它来写代码。 你可以用它来构建 Gadget，但也可以跳过 Gadget，直接让智能体执行任务。 Cloudflare OS 智能体是一个 Code Mode 智能体——它通过编写并立即执行代码片段来完成任务。 它可以通过 Gatekeeper（类似于 MCP——见下文）连接到外部资源。

sents.en: The Cloudflare OS coding agent is actually a fully multi-purpose agent that can perform arbitrary tasks; like other popular coding agents, you don't have to code with it.

sents.zh: 你可以用它来构建 Gadget，但也可以跳过 Gadget，直接让智能体执行任务。

sents.zh: Cloudflare OS 智能体是一个 Code Mode 智能体——它通过编写并立即执行代码片段来完成任务。

sents.en: It can be connected to external resources using Gatekeepers (like MCP -- see below).
sents.zh: 它可以通过 Gatekeeper（类似于 MCP——见下文）连接到外部资源。

paragraphs.en: While you can code a Gadget by hand if you want, the expectation is that AI writes the code for you. Cloudflare OS features a built-in coding agent that will build whatever you ask it, test it for you, and debug errors.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然你愿意的话可以手动编写 Gadget 的代码，但预期是由 AI 为你编写代码。 Cloudflare OS 内置了一个编码智能体，它会根据你的要求构建任何东西，为你进行测试，并调试错误。

sents.en: While you can code a Gadget by hand if you want, the expectation is that AI writes the code for you.
sents.zh: 虽然你愿意的话可以手动编写 Gadget 的代码，但预期是由 AI 为你编写代码。

sents.en: Cloudflare OS features a built-in coding agent that will build whatever you ask it, test it for you, and debug errors.
sents.zh: Cloudflare OS 内置了一个编码智能体，它会根据你的要求构建任何东西，为你进行测试，并调试错误。

paragraphs.en: You can choose your LLM. Cloudflare OS works with many major AI model providers and self-hosted models, with more providers being added all the time.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以选择你的 LLM。 Cloudflare OS 支持多家主流 AI 模型提供商以及自托管模型，并且不断有更多提供商加入。

sents.en: You can choose your LLM.
sents.zh: 你可以选择你的 LLM。

sents.en: Cloudflare OS works with many major AI model providers and self-hosted models, with more providers being added all the time.
sents.zh: Cloudflare OS 支持多家主流 AI 模型提供商以及自托管模型，并且不断有更多提供商加入。

paragraphs.en: Because of the tightly-integrated and simplified nature of the platform, even when using the same underlying AI models, the Cloudflare OS coding agent often performs better and faster with fewer tokens than a general-purpose coding agent would.
paragraphs.zh: 由于该平台高度集成且精简的特性，即使使用相同的底层 AI 模型，Cloudflare OS 编码智能体通常也能以更少的 token 实现比通用编码智能体更好、更快的表现。

paragraphs.en: Every app built with Cloudflare OS automatically has an agent-friendly API. That means, after you've asked AI to build the app, you can also ask AI to collaborate with you inside the app. No need to build an MCP server nor integrate a custom agent loop. It's just there by default.
paragraphs.zh: 每个用 Cloudflare OS 构建的应用都自动拥有一个对智能体友好的 API。 这意味着，在你让 AI 构建应用之后，你还可以让 AI 在应用内与你协作。 无需构建 MCP 服务器，也无需集成自定义的智能体循环。 它默认就在那里。

sents.en: Every app built with Cloudflare OS automatically has an agent-friendly API.
sents.zh: 每个用 Cloudflare OS 构建的应用都自动拥有一个对智能体友好的 API。

sents.en: That means, after you've asked AI to build the app, you can also ask AI to collaborate with you inside the app.
sents.zh: 这意味着，在你让 AI 构建应用之后，你还可以让 AI 在应用内与你协作。

sents.en: No need to build an MCP server nor integrate a custom agent loop.
sents.zh: 无需构建 MCP 服务器，也无需集成自定义的智能体循环。

sents.en: It's just there by default.
sents.zh: 它默认就在那里。

paragraphs.en: This works because the client and server portions of a Gadget are required to communicate via Cap'n Web RPC . This is a win-win:
paragraphs.zh: 这之所以有效，是因为 Gadget 的客户端部分和服务器部分必须通过 Cap'n Web RPC 进行通信。这是一个双赢的局面：

paragraphs.en: You can share your Gadget just like you'd share a document in a typical online office suite. You can give specific users access, or create a share link that provides access to anyone who opens it. And just like those online office suites, you'll be able to see your collaborators' actions in real time.
paragraphs.zh: 您可以像在典型的在线办公套件中共享文档一样共享您的 Gadget。 您可以向特定用户授予访问权限，或者创建一个分享链接，任何打开该链接的人都可以获得访问权限。 并且就像那些在线办公套件一样，您将能够实时看到协作者的操作。

sents.en: You can share your Gadget just like you'd share a document in a typical online office suite.
sents.zh: 您可以像在典型的在线办公套件中共享文档一样共享您的 Gadget。

sents.en: You can give specific users access, or create a share link that provides access to anyone who opens it.
sents.zh: 您可以向特定用户授予访问权限，或者创建一个分享链接，任何打开该链接的人都可以获得访问权限。

sents.en: And just like those online office suites, you'll be able to see your collaborators' actions in real time.
sents.zh: 并且就像那些在线办公套件一样，您将能够实时看到协作者的操作。

paragraphs.en: This works because every Gadget is backed by a Durable Object , Cloudflare's stateful serverless primitive which makes real-time multiplayer collaboration easy. It's so easy that the coding agent just implements it by default, without being asked.
paragraphs.zh: 这之所以可行，是因为每个 Gadget 都由一个 Durable Object 支撑，这是 Cloudflare 的有状态无服务器原语，让实时多人协作变得简单。 它简单到智能体无需被要求就会默认实现它。

sents.en: This works because every Gadget is backed by a Durable Object , Cloudflare's stateful serverless primitive which makes real-time multiplayer collaboration easy.
sents.zh: 这之所以可行，是因为每个 Gadget 都由一个 Durable Object 支撑，这是 Cloudflare 的有状态无服务器原语，让实时多人协作变得简单。

sents.en: It's so easy that the coding agent just implements it by default, without being asked.
sents.zh: 它简单到智能体无需被要求就会默认实现它。

paragraphs.en: If you've created a Gadget that might be useful to others, but you don't want to share the Gadget itself, you can instead share a Blueprint, allowing other people to create their own copy of the Gadget. A Blueprint is essentially a copy of the code.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你创建了一个可能对他人有用的「小工具」，但不想分享这个「小工具」本身，你可以改为分享一个「蓝图」，让其他人创建他们自己的「小工具」副本。 「蓝图」本质上就是代码的一份副本。

sents.en: If you've created a Gadget that might be useful to others, but you don't want to share the Gadget itself, you can instead share a Blueprint, allowing other people to create their own copy of the Gadget.
sents.zh: 如果你创建了一个可能对他人有用的「小工具」，但不想分享这个「小工具」本身，你可以改为分享一个「蓝图」，让其他人创建他们自己的「小工具」副本。

sents.en: A Blueprint is essentially a copy of the code.
sents.zh: 「蓝图」本质上就是代码的一份副本。

paragraphs.en: It may sound simple, but Blueprints are a major change from cloud software tradition. Traditionally, if you create a web app that you want to share with other users, you host the app on your server, and the users connect to that. Blueprints are much more like mobile apps and traditional PC apps: every user runs their own copy of the software.
paragraphs.zh: 这听起来可能很简单，但「蓝图」是对云端软件传统的一次重大改变。 传统上，如果你创建了一个想与其他用户分享的网页应用，你需要把应用托管在自己的服务器上，用户连接到该服务器。 蓝图更像移动应用和传统个人电脑应用：每个用户运行自己的一份软件副本。

sents.en: It may sound simple, but Blueprints are a major change from cloud software tradition.
sents.zh: 这听起来可能很简单，但「蓝图」是对云端软件传统的一次重大改变。

sents.en: Traditionally, if you create a web app that you want to share with other users, you host the app on your server, and the users connect to that.
sents.zh: 传统上，如果你创建了一个想与其他用户分享的网页应用，你需要把应用托管在自己的服务器上，用户连接到该服务器。

sents.en: Blueprints are much more like mobile apps and traditional PC apps: every user runs their own copy of the software.
sents.zh: 蓝图更像移动应用和传统个人电脑应用：每个用户运行自己的一份软件副本。

paragraphs.en: In the age of AI, this change is critically important. On one hand, AI empowers an individual developer to build more than ever, but it is still difficult for an individual developer to maintain an online service; this eliminates the need. On the other hand -- and even more importantly -- allowing each user to run their own copy of the software empowers the user to change the software to meet their needs, using AI. No need to file a feature request, no need to beg the developer to prioritize it. The end user can solve their own problems.
paragraphs.zh: 在人工智能时代，这一变革至关重要。 一方面，AI 赋能单个开发者，使其能构建前所未有的东西，但个人开发者仍然难以维护一项在线服务；这就消除了这种需求。 另一方面——甚至更重要——允许每个用户运行自己的软件副本，使用户能够借助 AI 修改软件以满足自己的需求。 无需提交功能请求，无需恳求开发者将其列为优先事项。 最终用户可以自己解决自己的问题。

sents.en: In the age of AI, this change is critically important.
sents.zh: 在人工智能时代，这一变革至关重要。

sents.en: On one hand, AI empowers an individual developer to build more than ever, but it is still difficult for an individual developer to maintain an online service; this eliminates the need.

sents.zh: 无需提交功能请求，无需恳求开发者将其列为优先事项。

sents.en: The end user can solve their own problems.
sents.zh: 最终用户可以自己解决自己的问题。

paragraphs.en: Each Gadget runs in a secure sandbox that prevents it from talking to the internet at all without your explicit consent. In particular:
paragraphs.zh: 每个 Gadget（小工具）都运行在一个安全的沙箱中，未经您的明确同意，它完全无法与互联网通信。具体而言：

paragraphs.en: Each agent, and each Gadget, by default has access to nothing. Even if you've configured the Gadget Workshop with access to external accounts, agents and Gadgets do NOT automatically get to use them.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体和每个 Gadget 默认情况下不拥有任何访问权限。 即使你已为 Gadget Workshop 配置了对外部账户的访问权限，智能体和 Gadget 也不会自动获得使用它们的权限。

sents.en: Each agent, and each Gadget, by default has access to nothing.
sents.zh: 每个智能体和每个 Gadget 默认情况下不拥有任何访问权限。

sents.en: Even if you've configured the Gadget Workshop with access to external accounts, agents and Gadgets do NOT automatically get to use them.
sents.zh: 即使你已为 Gadget Workshop 配置了对外部账户的访问权限，智能体和 Gadget 也不会自动获得使用它们的权限。

paragraphs.en: Instead, you must introduce each agent (or Gadget) to any particular resources you want it to access. For instance, you may introduce a GitHub repository by pasting a link to it, or clicking "add resource" and selecting it via the UI. An agent can also request an introduction to a resource it thinks it needs, which you can then provide or deny.
paragraphs.zh: 相反，你必须把你想让它访问的特定资源逐一介绍给每个智能体（或 Gadget）。 例如，你可以通过粘贴链接来介绍一个 GitHub 仓库，或者点击「add resource」并通过界面选择它。 智能体也可以请求介绍它认为自己需要的资源，然后你可以选择提供或拒绝。

sents.en: Instead, you must introduce each agent (or Gadget) to any particular resources you want it to access.
sents.zh: 相反，你必须把你想让它访问的特定资源逐一介绍给每个智能体（或 Gadget）。

sents.en: For instance, you may introduce a GitHub repository by pasting a link to it, or clicking "add resource" and selecting it via the UI.
sents.zh: 例如，你可以通过粘贴链接来介绍一个 GitHub 仓库，或者点击「add resource」并通过界面选择它。

sents.en: An agent can also request an introduction to a resource it thinks it needs, which you can then provide or deny.
sents.zh: 智能体也可以请求介绍它认为自己需要的资源，然后你可以选择提供或拒绝。

paragraphs.en: This differs from most agent harnesses, where MCP servers are configured upfront, making broad access to all your services ambiently available to the agent in every chat. Capability-based introductions keep each agent restricted to only the access it actually needs for the job at hand.
paragraphs.zh: 这与大多数智能体框架不同，在那些框架中，MCP 服务器是预先配置好的，使得对所有服务的广泛访问在每个对话中都可供智能体随意使用。 基于能力的引入机制使每个智能体仅限于访问其当前任务实际所需的权限。

paragraphs.en: We've built an online flow that helps you deploy to your own Cloudflare account:
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个在线流程，帮助你部署到自己的 Cloudflare 账户：

paragraphs.en: Or, for more sophisticated deployment, with your gatekeepers and potentially code changes, check out our deployment starter repo:
paragraphs.zh: 或者，如需更复杂的部署，包括你的门卫（gatekeepers）以及可能的代码更改，请查看我们的部署入门代码库：

paragraphs.en: https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-os-starter
paragraphs.zh: https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-os-starter

paragraphs.en: This runs Cloudflare OS using wrangler , the Workers developer tooling CLI. This is not the right way to run the OS on a production server, but it works fine for trying it out on your local machine.
paragraphs.zh: 这会使用 wrangler（Workers 开发者工具 CLI）来运行 Cloudflare OS。 这并不是在生产服务器上运行该 OS 的正确方式，但在本地机器上试用它完全没问题。

paragraphs.en: Your data will be stored in a subdirectory named .wrangler .
paragraphs.zh: 您的数据将存储在一个名为 .wrangler 的子目录中。

paragraphs.en: Cloudflare OS can run entirely on workerd , Cloudflare's open source runtime for Workers. In fact, the "run locally" instructions above use workerd under the hood. We are still working on documentation and tooling to help you smoothly deploy the OS on top of workerd on your own servers. If you are feeling adventurous, read the low-level documentation for workerd config (or point your agent at it) and have a go.

paragraphs.en: Many Gatekeepers require configuration in order to be able to connect to third-party services, including obtaining OAuth client credentials for each service. Unfortunately, many service providers intentionally do not make this easy, since the intended audience for OAuth is developers.
paragraphs.zh: 许多守门人（Gatekeeper）需要进行配置才能连接第三方服务，包括为每个服务获取 OAuth 客户端凭据。 遗憾的是，许多服务提供商故意不简化这一流程，因为 OAuth 的目标受众是开发者。

paragraphs.en: When developing, you'll want to run the front-end and back-end as two separate commands in two terminals:
paragraphs.zh: 在开发时，你需要在前端和后端两个终端中分别运行两条命令来启动它们：

paragraphs.en: pnpm dev-server pnpm dev-client Then visit: http://localhost:3000
paragraphs.zh: pnpm dev-server pnpm dev-client 然后访问：http://localhost:3000

paragraphs.en: At this time, we are not seeking outside contribution.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，我们不接受外部贡献。

paragraphs.en: AI has made writing code easy. The hard part, today, is not writing the code, but reviewing it, making sure quality stays high, and keeping the product coherent. In that light, unfortunately, external code contributions are "donating" the easy part of the job, while creating more of the hard work.
paragraphs.zh: AI 已经让编写代码变得容易。 如今，困难的部分不再是编写代码，而是审查代码、确保质量保持高水平，并保持产品的一致性。 遗憾的是，从这个角度看，外部的代码贡献是在“捐献”工作中容易的部分，却制造了更多困难的工作。

sents.en: AI has made writing code easy.
sents.zh: AI 已经让编写代码变得容易。

paragraphs.en: With that said, we are happy to accept small, trivially-verified PRs that fix a problem. However, we ask that you refrain from submitting low-value PRs (e.g. typo fixes) or PRs that are more than a dozen or so lines. Such PRs will be closed with a reference to this guideline.
paragraphs.zh: 话虽如此，我们乐意接受那些修复问题的小型、易于验证的 PR。 但是，我们请你避免提交低价值的 PR（例如错别字修复）或超过十几行左右的 PR。 此类 PR 将被关闭，并附上对此准则的引用。

paragraphs.en: If you have a big idea you'd like us to consider, feel free to open a discussion about it.
paragraphs.zh: 如果您有一个希望我们考虑的好主意，欢迎随时发起讨论。

paragraphs.en: This policy may change in the future as the project matures. Until then, thank you for your understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 随着项目逐渐成熟，此政策未来可能会发生变化。 在此之前，感谢您的理解。
